titles.title: SAFER Meat, Poultry, and Food Act

A bill to amend the Federal Meat Inspection Act, the Poultry Producers Inspection Act, and the Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act to provide for improved public heath and food safety through enhanced enforcement, and for other purposes.
SAFER Meat, Poultry, and Food Act
